req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint returns HTTP 204 on success and HTTP 404 when the task does not exist. The source shows delete_task returns bool; the handler raises 404 if False, returns None (204) if True. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing task, assert 204 and subsequent GET returns 404; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent task, assert exact 404 and error detail; (3) boundary BVA — delete task with id=1 (lowest seeded id) and id=20 (highest seeded id) to catch off-by-one mutations; (4) STC — delete same task twice, second call must return 404 (state transition: exists→deleted→not-found); (5) DT — delete with non-integer id path segment, assert 422 unprocessable entity. Each test uses an in-process SQLite DB reset via override of get_db so tests are isolated and idempotent.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists in the pre-loaded database
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
trace: R-TASK-013: system shall delete task and respond with confirmation
Catches mutation: 204 -> 200, None return -> body return, success bool flip
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

tf = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tf}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
session = TestSession()
session.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False))
session.commit()
session.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r = client.delete('/tasks/7')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b''
    r2 = client.get('/tasks/7')
    assert r2.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf)
